summary: This dataset description does not contain information about a specific dataset, but rather a career development plan for Dr. Saeed, an Instructor in Ophthalmology at Massachusetts Eye and Ear Infirmary. Dr. Saeed aims to study the genetic predispositions to developing Stevens Johnson Syndrome/toxic epidermal necrolysis (SJS/TEN) through a multi-center collaboration, leveraging the Harvard system's extensive resources and national experts in genetic epidemiology, SJS/TEN, and outcomes research. The study will involve whole exome sequencing to detect rare variants influencing pathogenesis and will focus on trimethoprim sulfamethoxazole (TS), a common inciting agent of SJS/TEN in the US.
